description: Source code for HTTP handling in a Git-related project, including cURL integration, SSL configuration, request management, and tracing/debugging functions.

methods.name: http_trace_curl_no_data
methods.description: Disables curl data tracing by overriding environment variable.

methods.name: setup_curl_trace
methods.description: Configures cURL handle for verbose debugging and tracing.

methods.name: http_append_auth_header
methods.description: Creates an Authorization header from credentials and appends it to headers list.

methods.name: redact_sensitive_header
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from headers, such as Authorization and Cookie headers.

methods.name: match_curl_h2_trace
methods.description: Parses curl HTTP/2 trace lines to identify header lines.

methods.name: redact_sensitive_info_header
methods.description: Redacts sensitive info in headers based on curl trace lines.

methods.name: curl_dump_header
methods.description: Logs HTTP headers with optional redaction.

methods.name: curl_dump_data
methods.description: Logs binary data in a human-readable format.

methods.name: curl_dump_info
methods.description: Logs informational data, applying redaction if needed.

methods.name: curl_trace
methods.description: Callback for curl debug info, logs headers, data, and info.

methods.name: get_curl_handle
methods.description: Initializes and configures a cURL handle with SSL, proxy, and protocol options.

methods.name: get_curl_allowed_protocols
methods.description: Returns bitmask of allowed protocols and appends protocol names to list.

methods.name: get_curl_http_version_opt
methods.description: Converts HTTP version string to cURL option value.
